title: release.yaml
description: Release contract for an app repo consumed by ravitejakamalapuram/release-platform.

app.description: Short slug used in artifact names and the dashboard.

test.description: Shell command run in the repo root before anything is built, uploaded or tagged. Non-zero exit aborts the release.

e2e.description: Optional end-to-end command. app-ci.yml runs it after each chrome build with EXTENSION_DIR set to the built extension directory. Tool setup (Playwright, Python, ...) is the command's job.

e2e_in_release.description: Also run `e2e` in the release pipeline (after the chrome build, before packaging). Default false.

version_file.description: File holding the current version (JSON with a top-level "version", build.gradle(.kts), pubspec.yaml, or a `version = x.y.z` line). Only used when the repo has no vX.Y.Z tag yet.

relativePath.patternHint: a relative path inside the repo without '..'

item_id.patternHint: the 32-letter Chrome Web Store item id

path.description: Directory containing manifest.json after the build step.

build.description: Optional build command, run in the repo root.

include.description: Allowlist of files/dirs/globs (relative to path). Default: everything minus common junk.

publish.description: Submit for review after upload (default true). false = upload a draft only.

listing.description: Optional store.config.json with the Chrome Web Store listing (descriptions, screenshots, promo images). Validated in PR checks; listing.yml prepares an upload checklist (the CWS API cannot change listings).

package.patternHint: an Android application id like com.example.app

listing.description: Optional fastlane-style metadata directory (<locale>/title.txt, short_description.txt, full_description.txt, images/...). Validated in PR checks; listing.yml syncs it to the Play store listing.

build.description: Custom build command instead of ./gradlew <gradle_task> (e.g. Flutter). VERSION_NAME and VERSION_CODE are exported.

ci_task.description: Gradle task for PR checks (app-ci.yml), built without signing secrets. Default assembleDebug.

ci_build.description: Custom PR-check build command instead of ./gradlew <ci_task> (e.g. flutter build apk --debug).

flutter.description: Install this Flutter version before building.

track.description: Play track to upload to (default internal).

release_status.description: completed (default) rolls out to the track; draft is required while the app itself is still a draft in Play Console.

release_notes.description: Markdown changelog; its first section becomes the en-US 'What's new' text.

signing.description: Names of the GitHub secrets (in the app repo) that hold the upload key.
